document.lead: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.

text: Twenty years ago, a university degree usually meant moving to another city and attending lectures in person. Today, an increasing number of students complete their entire studies on a laptop, often without ever meeting their lecturers. This essay will examine the main advantages and disadvantages of online degrees, which, in my view, suit some learners far better than others.

The most significant advantage is accessibility. Online courses allow people to study wherever they live, which is especially valuable in a large country like Kazakhstan, where many young people live far from major universities. Such courses are also usually cheaper, as students save on rent and travel, and they allow working adults and parents to fit their studies around jobs and families. In addition, recorded lectures can be paused and replayed, so students can learn at their own pace.

On the other hand, online study has significant drawbacks. Without the fixed timetable of a campus, many students struggle to stay motivated, and completion rates for online courses are often much lower than for traditional ones. Practical subjects such as medicine or engineering are difficult to teach through a screen, since they require laboratories and hands-on training. Finally, students miss out on the informal side of university life, including discussions with classmates, clubs and professional contacts, which often matter as much as the degree itself.

In conclusion, online degrees make higher education more flexible, affordable and accessible, particularly for people in remote areas or with jobs. However, they demand strong self-discipline and are less suitable for practical subjects, so for many school leavers a traditional campus remains the better choice.

note.en: States the plan of the essay.
The topic sentence of the advantages paragraph.
Highlights where the benefit matters most.
note.kk: Артықшылықтың қай жерде ерекше маңызды екенін көрсетеді.

note.en: A result: so students can learn at their own pace.
note.kk: Салдар: сондықтан өз қарқынымен оқуға болады.
note.ru: Следствие: поэтому можно учиться в своём темпе.

note.en: Explains why practical training is hard to move online.
note.kk: Практиканы онлайнға көшірудің неге қиын екенін түсіндіреді.
note.ru: Объясняет, почему практику трудно перенести онлайн.

strengths.en: Both sides of “What are the advantages and disadvantages” are developed equally.
strengths.kk: «What are the advantages and disadvantages» сұрағына екі жақ та бірдей толық ашылған.
strengths.ru: На вопрос «What are the advantages and disadvantages» обе стороны раскрыты одинаково подробно.

strengths.en: The conclusion does not just repeat; it says who each format suits.
strengths.kk: Қорытынды жай қайталамайды, қай формат кімге жақсырақ екенін айтады.
strengths.ru: Вывод не просто пересказывает, а говорит, кому какой формат лучше.
strengths.example: for many school leavers a traditional campus remains the better choice

strengths.en: Long distances in the country make the point about access convincing.
strengths.kk: Елдегі үлкен қашықтықтар қолжетімділік туралы дәлелді сенімді етеді.
strengths.ru: Большие расстояния в стране делают довод о доступности убедительным.
strengths.example: many young people live far from major universities

strengths.en: Each drawback comes with a reason rather than a bare claim.
strengths.kk: Әр кемшілікке жалаң тұжырым емес, себеп қосылған.
strengths.ru: К каждому минусу добавлена причина, а не голое утверждение.
strengths.example: since they require laboratories and hands-on training

note.en: Introduction: a then-and-now contrast and the plan. A “What are…” question needs no position, but a brief judgement strengthens the answer.
note.kk: Кіріспе: «ол кезде және қазір» салыстыру және жоспар. «What are…» сұрағында ұстаным міндетті емес, бірақ қысқа баға жауапты күшейтеді.
note.ru: Введение: сравнение «тогда и сейчас» и план. В вопросе «What are…» позиция не обязательна, но короткая оценка усиливает ответ.

note.en: Advantages: access (the Kazakhstan example), cost, flexibility and learning at one’s own pace — four points, each explained.
note.kk: Артықшылықтар: қолжетімділік (Қазақстан мысалы), бағасы, икемділік және өз қарқыны — түсіндірмесі бар төрт дәлел.
note.ru: Плюсы: доступность (пример Казахстана), цена, гибкость и свой темп — четыре довода с объяснениями.

note.en: Disadvantages: motivation, practical subjects and student life — as long as the advantages paragraph.
note.kk: Кемшіліктер: уәждеме, практикалық пәндер, студенттік өмір — абзацтың көлемі артықшылықтармен тең.
note.ru: Минусы: мотивация, практические предметы, студенческая жизнь — по объёму абзац равен плюсам.

note.en: Conclusion: the pros and cons summed up, and who each format suits.
note.kk: Қорытынды: артықшылықтар мен кемшіліктердің қорытындысы және қай формат кімге лайық.
note.ru: Вывод: итог плюсов и минусов и кому какой формат подходит.

document.title: Degrees studied online
document.question:
More and more universities now offer complete degree courses online, so students can earn a qualification without ever attending a campus. Some see this as the future of higher education, while others doubt that online study can replace the traditional university experience.

What are the advantages and disadvantages of this development?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
